controles.affirmation: Un jury a juge en 2022 que les produits Norton Security enfreignaient volontairement deux brevets de Columbia, dommages initiaux de 185 M$, dommages majores de 2,6 fois plus interets
controles.verbatim_source: The jury found that our Norton Security products and Symantec Endpoint Protection products ... willfully infringed two patents ... The jury awarded damages in the amount of $185 million. ... the court entered its judgment, which awarded Columbia (i) enhanced damages of 2.6 times the jury award; (ii) prejudgment interest, post-judgment interest, and supplemental damages

controles.affirmation: l'affaire a ete renvoyee en appel pour reexamen
controles.verbatim_source: The Federal Circuit issued its decision on appeal and remanded the case to the district court for further proceedings, including consideration of whether Columbia's patents are patent-eligible and, if the patent claims are determined to be eligible, to reduce the damages award to eliminate the royalty based on foreign sales and reconsider its attorneys' fees and enhanced damages decisions.
controles.correction_proposee: L'appel a deja eu lieu : la cour d'appel federale a rendu sa decision et renvoye l'affaire devant le tribunal de premiere instance, avec instruction de reduire les dommages (royalties sur ventes etrangeres) et de reexaminer les honoraires et les dommages majores.

controles.affirmation: Gen Digital provisionne une perte probable d'environ 256 M$, avec un risque assume de depassement non chiffrable
controles.verbatim_source: our current estimate of probable losses from this matter, within a range of potential outcomes, is approximately $256 million, which is accrued ... There is a reasonable possibility that a loss may be incurred in excess of our accrual for this matter; however, such incremental loss cannot be reasonably estimated.

controles.affirmation: Avast jugee responsable de violation du RGPD, amende de 351 M CZK (~16 M$) annulee sur le montant mais responsabilite confirmee, les deux parties pourvues en cassation
controles.verbatim_source: The Czech DPA issued a decision in March 2022 finding that Avast had violated the GDPR and issued a fine of CZK 351 million (approximately $16 million) ... On October 7, 2025, the court affirmed the decision regarding liability; however, it vacated the DPA's decision regarding the determination of the fine. Both the DPA and the Company have filed cassation complaints with the Supreme Administrative Law Court.

controles.affirmation: Une action collective distincte de consommateurs neerlandais reste pendante sans montant de dommages chiffre
controles.verbatim_source: Stichting CUIC - Privacy Foundation for Collective Redress, a Dutch foundation ... filed its writ of summons to initiate a collective action ... No specific amount of damages has been alleged to date. At this stage, the matter remains pending

controles.affirmation: le covenant bancaire de levier maximal a ete temporairement releve de 5,25x a 5,75x sur plusieurs trimestres, signe d'une marge de manoeuvre reduite
controles.verbatim_source: The Revolving Facility and Extended Term A Facility are subject to a covenant that we maintain a consolidated leverage ratio less than or equal to 5.25 to 1.0; provided that such maximum consolidated leverage ratio will increase to 5.75 to 1.0 for the four fiscal quarters ending immediately after we acquire property, business or assets in an aggregate amount greater than $250 million.
controles.correction_proposee: Le contrat de credit prevoit d'origine un relevement automatique du plafond de levier de 5,25x a 5,75x pendant les quatre trimestres suivant une acquisition de plus de 250 M$. Ce n'est pas un assouplissement obtenu sous contrainte : la citation de l'ATT s'arrete juste avant la condition d'acquisition, ce qui inverse le sens du passage.

controles.affirmation: Dette financiere totale 8,16 Mds $ pour 2,66 Mds $ de capitaux propres, ratio ~3 pour 1
controles.verbatim_source: Current portion of long-term debt 181 ... Long-term debt 7,975 ... Total stockholders' equity (deficit) 2,656

controles.affirmation: Le goodwill s'eleve a 10 938 M$ sur 15 644 M$ d'actifs (70%), ajustement recent de -51 M$, aucune depreciation a ce jour
controles.verbatim_source: Goodwill | 10,938 ... Total assets | $ 15,644 ... we recorded measurement period adjustments resulting in a decrease to goodwill of $51 million, net of tax ... Goodwill impairment evaluations have previously and may result in a charge to earnings.

controles.affirmation: Perte sur cession des avances Instacash 60 M$ contre 36 M$ (+67%), volume cede 1 193 M$ contre 823 M$ (+45%)
controles.verbatim_source: we sold $1,193 million and $823 million, respectively, of Instacash Advances under the Purchase Agreement ... we recognized $60 million and $36 million, respectively, in loss on the mark-to-market and sale of Instacash Advances

controles.affirmation: Chaque CVR donne droit a 23,00 $ en actions si le VWAP 30 jours atteint 37,50 $ avant le 17 avril 2027
controles.verbatim_source: Each CVR entitles its holder to receive $23.00 in shares of common stock ... if, on any date prior to the second anniversary of the closing, (i) the Average VWAP ... for 30 consecutive trading days is equal to or greater than $37.50 ... or (ii) we undergo a change of control
controles.correction_proposee: Ajouter le second declencheur omis : un changement de controle declenche aussi le paiement du CVR.

controles.affirmation: Remuneration totale du dirigeant en hausse de 46,5% a 22,51 M$, soit 276 fois la remuneration mediane, dont 88% en actions (DEF14A 28 juillet 2026)
controles.verbatim_source: DEF14A du 28 juillet 2026 : 'Mr. Pilette's FY26 annual total compensation was $83,582,308' ; 'the pay ratio of the annual total compensation of our CEO to the median of the annual total compensation of our employees is 900 to 1'
controles.correction_proposee: Chiffres perimes d'un exercice : 22,51 M$ et 276:1 sont les donnees FY2025 du proxy du 28 juillet 2025. Le document cite (proxy 2026) indique 83,58 M$ (+271% sur un an) et un ratio de 900 pour 1, dont 96% en actions.

controles.affirmation: Prime annuelle du dirigeant basee a 100% sur la croissance des bookings avec seuil de profit operationnel et modificateur -/+10%
controles.verbatim_source: 100% based on Bookings growth with an operating profit gate. Final payout subject to a responsible business modifier -/+ 10%

controles.affirmation: Trust-Based Solutions 490 M$ +26,3%, Cyber Safety Platform 846 M$ -2,6%, effet calendaire d'une semaine supplementaire
controles.verbatim_source: Cyber Safety Platform $846 $869 | Trust-Based Solutions 490 388 | Total net revenues $1,336 $1,257 ... Revenue from Cyber Safety Platform decreased $23 million ... primarily due to an impact of $56 million from the additional week ... Revenue from Trust-Based Solutions increased $102 million

controles.affirmation: Dependance a Broadcom pour le moteur de detection Norton, accord a duree limitee, perte de capacites de threat intelligence
controles.verbatim_source: We are dependent upon Broadcom for certain engineering and threat response services, which are critical to many of our products and business ... provided under a license agreement with a limited term ... we lost other capabilities, including certain threat intelligence data
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance possible : le filing precise aussi 'we retain rights to use, modify, enhance and create derivative works from such technology', ce qui attenue la dependance.

controles.affirmation: Investissement en R&D maintenu a 8% du chiffre d'affaires
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2026 : 'Research and development | 8 | 8' (en % du chiffre d'affaires, exercices 2026 et 2025)
